summary: Re-tested the AdminLayouts route wiring fix and full block-orchestration end-to-end flow. All frontend assertions PASS. /admin/layouts route is now registered, the discoverability tile ('layouts-admin-link') is visible on /admin and routes correctly, the editor renders with save-layout-btn + reset-layout-btn + tab-dice_page + slot-select-live_feed, and moving live_feed right→left + Save propagates to /dice (2-col grid collapses to single column).
